body:
I can confirm this on 4.7.rc eb03ae8fc (Linux) on the 2D platformer demo. On that demo:

- Open `game_singleplayer.tscn` and another scene like `coin.tscn`.
- Open `game.gd` in the script editor.
- Switch to the 2D tab, switch to `coin.tscn` then back to `game_singleplayer.tscn`.
- Notice how it switches to the Script tab. This does not occur on subsequent scene changes, until you close the script and reopen it.
- Before switching back-and-forth from/to the scene, selecting any other node that has a script attached can also cause this to happen on the first scene change (try this with the Player node in `game_singleplayer.tscn`, having `player.gd` open the script editor).

This occurs the first time you open a script in the editor, then switch back to a scene whose root node has the script attached. To reproduce the issue again, close both the scenes and scripts, then reopen them.

Bisecting it now.

**Edit:** I bisected the regression to https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/116905. cc @KoBeWi
